item.title: The Florida Legislature needs to be held accountable for school funding
item.description: "When the lottery was approved, the funds were to be used to give our schools extras. At that time, our state budget had a large budget line for fully funding our schools. The legislature drastically cut the budget funding for schools and replaced it with the lottery. They pulled the wool over the voters' eyes and spent the school budget on other "necessary expenses" that were not on the budget.
